description: Design: Large, right-handed ergonomic frame with rubber side grips.The Cushion: M850 L includes an integrated soft palm cushion. Sensor: Advanced Optical Tracking adjustable from 400 to 4000 DPI. Buttons: 6 customizable buttons with whisper-quiet SilentTouch clicks. Scroll Wheel: SmartWheel shifts automatically from line-by-line precision to high-speed free-spin. Connectivity: Connects to up to 3 devices via Bluetooth Low Energy or the secure Logi Bolt USB-C receiver. Operating Range: Reliable wireless connection up to 10 metres (33 feet). Battery: Runs for up to 24 months (2 years) on a single replaceable AA battery.Software: Fully customizable macros and profiles via the Logi Options+ app (Windows and macOS).
